title: Risk Policy — Stop Loss
text: Capital preservation first. Every trade requires a stop loss placed at the invalidation level before entry. No position without defined invalidation.

title: Risk Policy — Leverage Limits
text: Leverage is capped at 5x on paper and demo accounts. Raising leverage requires owner approval and a written reason. Isolated margin only.

title: Risk Policy — Position Sizing
text: Risk at most 1% of account equity per trade. Position size is derived from the distance between entry and stop. Reduce size after two consecutive losses.

title: Risk Policy — Daily Loss Limit
text: Stop trading for the day after a 3% drawdown in account equity. The kill switch halts new paper orders until the next session.

title: Trading Playbook — Human Approval
text: Human approval is required before any executable order. The agent must not bypass approval or risk checks.

title: Trading Playbook — Session Routine
text: Before the London open review the higher timeframe levels, mark liquidity zones and write the day's bias in the journal.

title: Trading Playbook — News Events
text: Do not open new positions fifteen minutes before or after high impact news such as CPI or FOMC releases. Flatten scalps ahead of scheduled announcements.

title: Trade Journal — Revenge Trade
text: Lesson: after a revenge trade, enforce a cooldown period. Emotional trading violates the playbook.

title: Trade Journal — ETH Breakout Win
text: ETHUSDT breakout above the weekly high held on retest. Took partial profit at 2R and trailed the remainder.

title: Trade Journal — SOL Overtrading
text: Took nine SOLUSDT scalps in one afternoon. Fees ate the gains. Lesson: cap the number of trades per session.

title: Trade Journal — BTC Late Entry
text: Entered a BTCUSDT long after the move was extended and the stop was too wide. Lesson: wait for the pullback instead of chasing.

title: HTF Trend Pullback Template
text: Pullback entry rules: trade only with higher timeframe trend alignment. Wait for pullback into value on BTC setups.

title: ETH Trend Pullback Template
text: Trend pullback entry rules for ETH: enter on a pullback to the 4h moving average when the daily trend is up.

title: ETH Range Reversion Template
text: Range reversion rules for ETH: fade the range extremes only when volume declines. Exit at the range midpoint.

title: Breakout Retest Template
text: Breakout retest entry rules: wait for a candle close above resistance and enter on the retest with the stop below the breakout level.

title: Mistakes Database — FOMO
text: Common mistake: chasing green candles due to FOMO. Apply green day guard before adding risk.

title: Mistakes Database — Moving the Stop
text: Common mistake: widening the stop loss after entry to avoid being stopped out. Never move a stop further from entry.

title: Mistakes Database — Overleverage
text: Common mistake: using maximum leverage on low conviction setups. Leverage magnifies small errors into account damage.
